title: centaurea nigrescens subsp. pinnatifida
intro: Centaurea nigrescens subsp. pinnatifida, commonly known as Mountain Knapweed, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Knapweed are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging properties. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea nigrescens subsp. pinnatifida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic and health-promoting effects.
